card.name: Comma after baseline in monitoring schedules
card.fires_on: The comma (or following space/"at") right after "baseline" or "start of treatment" in lists of when to check liver tests or blood counts. It marks the point where the next monitoring time is about to be named.

modes.label: Comma after baseline
modes.description: Comma following "baseline" or "start of treatment" in a lab-monitoring schedule, before the next time point.
modes.example: include monitoring of liver enzyme tests at baseline<<,>> prior to dose escalation and at two weeks

modes.label: Other schedule breaks
modes.description: A space or "at" at a similar spot in a timed schedule, such as after "until" or after a semicolon following baseline.
modes.example: Monitor liver tests at baseline;<< at>> Weeks 3, 5,
